title: Software Engineer
description:
Qualcomm France-QITC mission is to develop and deploy highly configurable custom-built interconnect hardware IPs, software tools, and exploration and verification methodologies so that SoC integration teams can quickly assemble SoCs with the desired Power Performance Area (PPA) characteristics.

The team delivers CAD tools which allow the designer to describe interconnects as high-level abstraction features. The tools choose, configure and connect the appropriate unit part of the library of HW IP developed at QITC. The software also allows from a properly configured design to export all sorts of collaterals: Verilog descriptions, SystemC models, excel sheets, pre-configured verification environments, etc.

Responsibilities:
- Gathering requirements and designing new features to enhance the possibilities of the tools: IP assembly and configuration, collaterals generation, GUI
- Participating to releases planning and deliveries
- Monitoring code quality and regression status

Working environment: Linux, Git, Qt, Python OOP, C++

Minimum Qualifications:
- Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field

Preferred Qualifications:
- Fluent in software design best practices
- Good knowledge in object-oriented programming
- Good Python skills
- Experience in profiling and code optimization
- Experience developing a software intensive tool
- Strong interest in hardware technologies (RTL Verilog, VHDL, SystemC, Arduino or electronics)
